newsitem.title: USA: Kimberly-Clark to up Europe diaper capacity.
newsitem.headline: Kimberly-Clark to up Europe diaper capacity.

text.p: Kimberly-Clark Corp said on Wednesday it would planned to increase production capacity at its diaper manufacturing facility in England by more than 30 percent, to meet growing demand for Huggies diapers in Europe.

It said it would invest in new production equipment for its facility at Barton-upon-Humber, England, with start-up expected within the next 15 months. The expansion would also add about 80 jobs to the plant, which now employs over 550 people, the company said.

John Van Steenberg, president of Kimberly-Clark Europe, said: "We are delighted with the way Huggies diapers have been received in Europe. In less than three years, Kimberly-Clark has gone from having no presence in the European diaper market to being the number two diaper producer."
The company said in Britain and France, its market share accounted for over 25 percent of the $1.2 billion in diaper sales in those countries.
